opus.problem: Too easy. 'The sheep on His right and these on His left' is the famous sheep-and-goats pairing, so most bakers would name the word from this clue alone. The rule says no single clue gives it away.
Not fully supported by its verse. Genesis 37:31 covers only slaughtering the young goat and dipping the robe. Sending the robe to Jacob is in 37:32, so either widen the reference or drop that part.
